newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's MIBANK raises 96 profit 47.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's MIBANK raises 96 profit 47.6 pct.

text.p: Misr International Bank/MIBANK said on Monday it made net unaudited profits for calendar 1996 of 141 million pounds compared to 96 million in the previous year.
The private bank said in a published announcement that assets increased by 9.6 percent to 9.34 billion and deposits were slightly higher at 7.87 billion from 7.19 billion in 1995.
Last month, the bank approved a five-for-one share split to stimulate trading in the stock. The bank has shares denominated in Egyptian pounds and U.S. dollars.
MIBANK is also planning to increase its capital and is vetting 10 global securities houses before offering shares on the international scene through a global depositary receipt.

State-run Banque Misr holds 44.8 percent of MIBANK and Misr Insurance four percent. Banca di Roma has 10 percent, Luxembourg-based Europartners Holdings 7.9, Sakura Bank Ltd of Japan 2.6 and British Arab Commercial Bank 8.5 percent. Individuals own the remaining 22.2 percent.
